collision_note: Every collected call in this file queried the bare ticker 'SMR' with no region override. The harness's active session region was IN (collected.json:18,74). Because NYSE:SMR (NuScale Power Corp, this pack's target) and BSE 544774 (SMR Jewels Ltd, an unrelated Indian SME, battery slot S2) share the literal ticker string, and none of the money-relevant symbol-scoped routes (/quotes/{symbol}, /fundamentals/{symbol} and its /income /balance /cashflow /ratings children) accept a region override, almost every field below compares NuScale's true value against SMR Jewels' real (but entirely unrelated) value. The one exception is /fundamentals/{symbol}/income|balance|cashflow, which is served by a DIFFERENT provider (openbb-mcp) whose own bare-symbol default happens to favour the US listing, so those specific fields are genuinely correct here (see field #40) -- coincidentally, since the identical mechanism serves the WRONG entity for the mirror case (battery slot P9, ticker AMAL; see census/raw/data-P9_AMAL.json DAT-P9-1). See census/raw/data-P20_SMR.json DAT-P20-1 for the filed finding and code evidence.
